name: week
title: This week in the volunteer program
subtitle: Volunteers for Claude Code: what needs a decision, the roster ahead and the checks running out, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Needs a decision
sections.note: Worst first. Anyone rostered without clearance, a barred check or an unreported notifiable incident outranks everything.
sections.sql: select reason as why, label as record, who, program, days, detail from v_attention order by rank, days desc nulls last

sections.title: The next 14 days
sections.note: Filled against needed. A shift with someone not cleared shows it in the last column.
sections.sql: select s.ref as shift, to_char(s.shift_on, 'Dy DD Mon') as day, to_char(s.starts, 'HH24:MI') || '-' || to_char(s.ends, 'HH24:MI') as time, s.role, s.location as place, s.filled || ' of ' || s.needed as filled, (select count(*) from v_roster_problems p where p.shift = s.ref) as not_cleared from v_shifts s where s.status = 'open' and s.shift_on between current_date and current_date + 14 order by s.shift_on, s.starts

sections.title: Checks to act on
sections.note: Expired, unverified, barred, or running out inside 60 days.
sections.sql: select volunteer_ref as ref, volunteer, check_name(kind, jurisdiction) as check_held, number, to_char(good_until, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as good_until, state from v_checks where volunteer_status in ('active', 'applicant') and (state not in ('CURRENT', 'WITHDRAWN') or good_until <= current_date + 60) order by array_position(array['BARRED','EXPIRED','NOT VERIFIED','PENDING','EXPIRING'], state), good_until

name: hours
title: Hours and people
subtitle: Volunteer hours by program, who has stopped coming and who has earned a thank you, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Hours by program and month
sections.note: Approved hours only, the last six months.
sections.sql: select program, to_char(period, 'Mon YYYY') as month, volunteers, round(minutes / 60.0, 1) as hours from v_program_hours where period >= date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '5 months' order by program, period

sections.title: Quietly stopped coming
sections.note: Active, nothing rostered, no shift or hours for longer than settings.quiet_after_days.
sections.sql: select v.ref, v.name, to_char(greatest(v.last_shift_on, v.last_hours_on, v.started_on), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as last_seen, current_date - greatest(v.last_shift_on, v.last_hours_on, v.started_on) as days, round(v.minutes_total / 60.0) as hours_all_time from v_volunteers v cross join settings s where v.status = 'active' and v.next_shift_on is null and greatest(v.last_shift_on, v.last_hours_on, v.started_on) <= current_date - s.quiet_after_days order by days desc

sections.title: Milestones to recognise
sections.sql: select ref, name, milestone from v_milestones order by ref
